clauses.clause: Whenever this creature attacks while you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.

mapping.notes: 'While you control a creature with power 4 or greater' qualifies the event (read once at the declaration): Ornery Dilophosaur's comparison over number_you_control(...) in the DeclareAttackersEvent filter. +1/+0 and menace until end of turn on this creature. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/courageous_goblin_no_bonus_without_your_big_creature.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/courageous_goblin_bonus_and_menace_end_with_the_turn.json. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
